lines.en: Kirin and I decide to spend the night walking around the city district, looking for various ways to kill time.
lines.zh: 我和 Kirin 决定晚上在市区四处走走，找各种消磨时间的方式。

lines.en: She drags me around to a few of her favorite hang-out spots and is surprisingly clingy the entire time, refusing to let go of my arm even when I tell her to.
lines.zh: 她拉着我去逛了几个她最喜欢的地方，全程出奇地黏人，我叫她松手，她也不肯放开我的胳膊。

lines.en: It's almost like she wants to be seen like this.
lines.zh: 简直像是她想被人看到这副样子。

lines.en: Eventually, we run out of places to visit and decide to simply sit with our backs against the wall of some old building, talking about life and what we think comes next.
lines.zh: 最后我们实在没地方可去了，就干脆背靠着某栋旧楼的墙坐下，聊人生，聊我们觉得接下来会是什么。

lines.en: We decide that the answer is nothing and that death will just bring eternal darkness.
lines.zh: 我们得出的答案是：什么都没有，死亡只会带来永恒的黑暗。

lines.en: One I don't think I'd be able to have with anyone but her.
lines.zh: 我觉得除了她，我没法跟任何人拥有这样的夜晚。

lines.en: And even though our words and theories are as dark as the night sky, I can't help but feel like the two of us have managed to bond.
lines.zh: 尽管我们的话语和论调像夜空一样漆黑，我还是忍不住觉得我们俩之间产生了某种羁绊。

lines.en: Albeit in a very strange sort of way.
lines.zh: 虽然是以一种非常奇怪的方式。
